column1: # Hand-written Chinese-to-English translations of common developer terms.
# Format: chinese<TAB>english[<TAB>english]. At most two translations; the first is shown first.
# These entries replace CC-CEDICT and ECDICT for the same headword (scripts/english/build-translations.py).
# Put the technical sense first and keep a common everyday sense second (仓库: repository, warehouse).
# Single-character headwords are not allowed: the input method does not translate them.
